# NFL Secondary Statistics: Coverage Scheme Stats & Rates

By [Sharp Football Staff](https://www.sharpfootballanalysis.com/author/sfa-staff/)\|2026-11-03T09:29:56-05:00Nov 3, 2026\|

What coverages do NFL defenses play? We break down the leaders, looking at every metric including man coverage rate, zone coverage rate, and more.

_Updated: November 3_
